rootCause: The transactional reservation primitive accepted caller-created available/reflected maps without a canonical account-evidence compiler or database-loaded intent/fill intersection. The existing normalized account numbers also lost the original exact broker decimal representation.
implemented: Existing bounded account GET now additionally preserves exact capital decimal strings. Missing options buying power never falls back to margin buying power.
Strict cash-secured-put account evidence compiler checks physical account, snapshot, observation window, policy identity, contract metadata, completeness, and required balances.
Exact fixed-scale cash and policy exposure include filled positions plus only unfilled opening quantities. Pending closing orders do not free capital.
Broker-net options buying power is kept separate from internal secured-cash and policy capacities.
Soft limits remain visible and candidate-bound AEGIS reassessment remains mandatory. The hard boundary retains existing greater-than-or-equal veto semantics.
Multi-underlying sector/correlation evidence is required explicitly. A sole-underlying proxy is labeled rather than presented as empirical taxonomy.
Qualified reservation transaction loads active commitments and account-bound intent, broker-order and immutable fill lineage under the physical-account lock.
Proven pending-order policy/cash intersections are credited only once. Unproven broker-BP attribution and filled-position lot intersections stay held.
Bounded qualification evidence persists in the existing immutable envelope, without a new table or alternate execution authority.
Restart replay reuses immutable qualification, validates observation identity, and preserves idempotent claims. Freshness is checked after acquiring the account lock.
Unsupported native-leg, inventory or assignment inputs refuse qualification rather than being modeled as a zero-risk cash-secured account.
